evidence.observation: O2 reverses its purge-phase decay and begins climbing at growth onset (13.5 ppm)
monotonic rise to 54.5 ppm over 10 min of growth at steady Ar 100 sccm
temperature holds 750 °C with normal heater power; thermal control looks fine
pressure gauge not installed, so tube atmosphere cannot be cross-checked

args.missing_evidence: No pressure channel; an Ar-flow step test (leak signature: O2 varies inversely with dilution flow) or an O2 sensor zero/span check would separate real air ingress from sensor drift.
